# Deprecated initializer in iOS 17 (2025-07-17 16:45Z)

_**User (2025-07-17 16:01Z)**_

'init(coordinateRegion:interactionModes:showsUserLocation:userTrackingMode:annotationItems:annotationContent:)' was deprecated in iOS 17.0: Use Map initializers that take a MapContentBuilder instead.

---

_**Assistant**_

You are correct: the Map initializer you are using is deprecated as of iOS 17.0. The new approach is to use the Map initializers that take a MapContentBuilder, which provides more flexibility and future-proofs your code.

Here’s how you can update your code:

### What to Change

Replace this (deprecated):
```swift
Map(coordinateRegion: $region, annotationItems: nearestDevices) { item in
    MapAnnotation(coordinate: item.coordinate) {
        // ...
    }
}
```

With this (iOS 17+):
```swift
Map(position: $region) {
    ForEach(nearestDevices) { item in
        Annotation(item.name, coordinate: item.coordinate) {
            VStack(spacing: 2) {
                MiataruMapMarker(color: item.color, height: 16, pulsing: false)
                Text(item.name)
                    .font(.caption2)
                    .foregroundColor(.primary)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 4)
                    .background(Color(.systemBackground).opacity(0.7))
                    .clipShape(Capsule())
            }
            .onTapGesture {
                selectedDeviceID = item.id
            }
        }
    }
}
```

- Use `Map(position: $region)` instead of `Map(coordinateRegion: $region, ...)`.
- Use `ForEach` and `Annotation` inside the Map’s content builder.
- The rest of your logic (onAppear, onChange, etc.) can remain the same.

### Compatibility

If you need to support both iOS 16 and 17, you can use an `if #available(iOS 17, *)` check to provide both implementations.

Would you like me to update your file with this change? If so, do you want to support iOS 16 as well, or only iOS 17+?
